subject: Captured errors should be formatted as such. (#390)
reason: The change is confined to the unit-test infrastructure: vmsdk/src/testing_infra/module.h's ReplyCapture mock (used only by gtest) now formats captured errors as RESP errors ('-msg') instead of bulk strings, and testing/ft_create_test.cc, ft_info_test.cc and ft_search_test.cc update their expected strings accordingly. No production/runtime code of the module changes, so a running server's replies are identical on the change and its parent; there is no behaviour a fuzzer scenario could reach or compare.
